title: $30 off Your in-Store Purchase with Afterpay "Pay in 4" (Minimum $100 Spend) @ Afterpay (App & Digital Wallet Required)
body:
Deal: $30 off Your in-Store Purchase with Afterpay "Pay in 4" (Minimum $100 Spend) @ Afterpay (App & Digital Wallet Required)

[Lordeee] I didn't get an email but It worked when I added it under the promotions tab (maybe cause I've never used afterpay in store)
[safrane] I can confirm the code works without the Email, if you've never used Afterpay in-store before. 14 day expiry from code activation.
[cook99] Targeted. Have never used afterpay in store and code doesn't work when trying to apply, also no email.
[lovesabargain77] Tried manually entering the code and got the message 'Promo code is not valid'.
I've previously used an in-store offer of $30 off $80, so that is possibly the reason it doesn't work for me.
[Craicdealer] You can sort by in-store here -https://www.afterpay.com/en-AU/categories/new?has_in_store=true $100 El Jannah chicken anyone? Only place in-store in the Melbourne CBD according to the website filter. I am looking for gift cards but yet to find an option…
[thomalfa] That would a lot of chicken to feed the family for days… if i remember correctly chem wh and jb are also accepting afterpay instore payment.
It’s like mastercard just split to 4 payments
[gadgetguy] I got the email and it shows the logos for Kmart, Bunnings, Myer, Target, BigW and Chemist Warehouse so I'm assuming they are all included.
[Sweet3st] Definitely targeted. I have never used Afterpay for instore and I get 'promo code invalid'.
[gadgetguy] Can they tell if you use it to buy a gift card in store?
